title: CRAZY NEW BIKE BUILD: AF Bicycles AF01 SSL + Imtos Touris Pro Handlebar + 44mm Road Tires

takeaways.text: Stack and reach match an endurance road bike; chainstays and fork are as short as 50 mm clearance allows, and the seat tube is 3–4 cm shorter than comparable sizes, so sizing up two sizes kept standover workable.
Uses a round 27.2 mm seatpost with a 45-degree grub-screw expansion clamp rather than a band clamp, so standard, setback or reversed posts fit.
Open down-tube storage with a bag and custom tool, T47, UDH, a bolt-on front-derailleur tab for 2×, and close to 30 accessory mounts across frame and fork.
AF says the SSL premium version uses a different layup that saves about 200 g across frame and fork compared with the standard AF01.
The XXL SSL build with 105 Di2, 32 mm-internal wheels and 40C tires (measuring 42 mm) weighed just under 8 kg without pedals or bottles, and 7.35 kg with road wheels and a lighter cassette.
After about 300 km the rounded tubes showed little bottom-bracket or head-tube flex for a heavy rider, and the 72-degree head angle gave calm handling.

disclosure: The presenter bought the frame at a discount arranged with AF Bicycles and uses affiliate links; the aero handlebar was supplied free by its maker.
summary: Randonneuring build of an XXL AF01 in the SSL premium layup with 105 Di2 and 40C road tires, with fit reasoning, weights and first 300 km impressions.
